title: Grocery Round subscriptions buy credits, and credits are not money
decision: A subscription payment is consideration for a supply of groceries, not a repayable sum. Credits are not money, not redeemable in money, not transactional and not transferable. Dial therefore holds an obligation to deliver groceries rather than customer money.
consequence: ACT-REG-001 is NOT ENGAGED by Grocery Rounds, and no second money-holding model is ratified. This holds only while credits settle grocery fulfilment and nothing else; a credit spendable across trades re-engages the blocker on worse facts, with real customer value already inside it.
supersedes: GROCERY_ROUNDS_MASTER_PLAN_v1.md §2, the review finding B1 conflict
reopens_if: any credit becomes settleable outside grocery fulfilment, or any redemption returns money

title: Credits carry monetary value, and the member carries the price risk
decision: A credit is a dollar amount of future groceries, not a fixed quantity of them. Dial's obligation is discharged by delivering that value at the prices current when the Round collects.
consequence: Food inflation falls on the member. Review finding B3 therefore closes by disclosure rather than by construction: the consent gateway must state, in the member's words, that credits are a dollar amount and not a fixed shopping list.
reopens_if: the commercial decision is taken to absorb price risk through forward supply contracts and denominate in goods

title: VAT is accounted for when the member pays, and a Round carries one credit pool per tax character
decision: The tax point is payment, per VAT Act [Chapter 23:12] s8 (earlier of invoice or payment). Deferral to collection is available only against a written ZIMRA ruling recorded on the Round product. Each Round declares credit pools, one per tax character, each with its own catalogue; a payment splits across pools at a ratio fixed when it is taken.
consequence: The rate is determined on the day money arrives even though the basket is chosen months later, because the pool fixes the menu rather than the shopping list. SI 248 of 2023 made the staples basket EXEMPT from 1 Jan 2024, so the flagship pool bears no output VAT and its input VAT is irrecoverable — a permanent cost that no tax-point choice touches, and the largest tax number in the product. IMTT is charged per instalment and is modelled. Rates resolve from a dated schedule; the standard rate moved 15% to 15.5% on 1 Jan 2026.
supersedes: ROUND_CREDIT_MODEL_v1.md Rev 2 decision 1, which placed the tax point at collection
reopens_if: counsel confirms a monetary-voucher provision permitting taxation on redemption, or the exempt schedule changes

title: The tax point is not revenue recognition
decision: Consideration for an unsettled credit is a contract liability. Revenue is recognised when the groceries transfer, never when the money arrives.
consequence: Booking credit sales as revenue at payment would report unearned profit, attract income tax on it, and tell management the float is spendable margin — which is review finding B2's failure mode reached through the ledger.
reopens_if: never — this is an accounting standard, not a preference

title: A leaving member receives groceries at standard retail, without Round benefits
decision: Credits are owned individually. A member may leave at any time and receives groceries to the value of their credits at standard retail prices, with no Round pricing, no free delivery and no other Round benefit. Carrying credits to the next Round remains available. Cash never is. The group vote decides when the Round procures, not whether a member may leave.
consequence: Permanent non-redeemability is defensible because a substantial in-kind remedy exists. Without it, an ordered cash refund would create the repayable sum DEC-001 exists to avoid.
reopens_if: counsel advises the in-kind exit is insufficient under the Consumer Protection Act [Chapter 14:44]

title: A protection charge rides on top of credit value, flat, and is never a member premium
decision: A charge of about 4% of credit value is collected in addition to it — 5,200 buys 5,000 of credit and 200 towards cover. It does not vary with the member's pool split. Dial buys cover for Dial's own delivery obligation; the member is never the policyholder or beneficiary.
consequence: Disclosing that part of the price funds protection is lawful and permitted, and obliges accuracy: cover must be bound before it is described, and the disclosure must state insurer, scope, limits, exclusions and eligibility — including that cover does not reach ordinary commercial shortfall. Presenting the charge as a premium the member pays an insurer would be intermediation requiring IPEC registration Dial does not hold.
reopens_if: the broker quote lands materially away from 4%

title: Dial authors pools and catalogues; creators configure commerce; members choose their split
decision: Which pools exist and every item on each catalogue is authored by Dial. The Round creator sets the default split and the band members may move within. The member chooses their own split inside that band, for future instalments only. Voting weight in a pool follows credits held in that pool.
consequence: Tax classification is never a creator-facing knob: a creator who put a standard-rated item on a staples menu would mis-state a VAT return with no feedback loop to tell them. Pool-weighted voting also prevents members who bear none of a pool's cost from deciding how it is spent, which is review finding M4 in a new place.
reopens_if: never for pool authorship; the split bands are commercial and may be retuned

title: The margin and pricing engine is PLAT-F014, cross-division, Groceries first
decision: A single calculation authority computes contribution and profit for any priced product from evidenced cost inputs. It is allocated to the existing PLAT-F014 (PricePolicy, owner commercial/pricing) rather than a new Feature ID. The calculation contract is designed cross-division from day one; only the Grocery Rounds inputs land in v1. It is not a ledger, not a price setter, and not a dashboard in v1.
consequence: PLAT-F014 already exists and already owns pricing and commercial policy, so no new module or Feature ID is invented. Shape is the expensive thing to change and inputs are not, which is why the contract goes wide immediately and the data does not. Cost-input ownership sits with commercial/pricing, PLAT-F014's registered owner, and the overhead allocation basis is decided once and serves both this engine and RCM-021's input-tax apportionment.
reopens_if: the engine is asked to post a ledger entry or set a customer price without a human decision, at which point it has become something else

title: The first vertical slice is Grocery Rounds §26
decision: The milestone is the Grocery Rounds vertical slice at STAGING_GREEN — the master plan's sixteen §26 steps, from create Round to reconcile and complete.
consequence: Chosen because it is buildable now: the money model is locked, the regulatory questions are closed by research, the protection rate has a defensible figure, and the sandbox EscrowAdapter exists. The Spare slice would today prove the plumbing rather than the product, because the pilot pack's hand-authored DGM ids are rejected by isProductionDgmId and the eleven-stage gate correctly reports zero ready vehicles. Spare becomes the stronger slice when a real catalogue lands.
reopens_if: a real catalogue is injected before the Rounds slice completes, which would make the Spare slice the better proof

title: Round credits are not deposit-taking, on the Banking Act's own cumulative test
decision: The Banking Act [Chapter 24:20] defines banking business cumulatively: accepting deposits withdrawable or repayable, AND employing those deposits by lending or any other means. Round credits fail both limbs independently — nothing is repayable, and consideration buys grocery stock rather than being lent.
consequence: The deposit-taking question is closed for build. One gap remains and does not block: the National Payment Systems Act stored-value position was not examined, and the closed-loop non-transferable construction is the standard exclusion in such regimes rather than a checked Zimbabwean text.
reopens_if: any credit becomes repayable in money, or float is employed by lending or investment rather than procurement

title: Insuring Dial's own obligation and pricing it in triggers no IPEC registration
decision: The Insurance Act [Chapter 24:07] defines an agent as acting on behalf of a registered insurer, a broker as negotiating on behalf of another person, and insurance business as assuming an insurer's obligations. Dial insuring its own delivery obligation and recovering the cost inside the product price is none of the three.
consequence: Disclosing that part of the price funds protection is lawful and obliges accuracy — cover bound before it is described, and scope, limits and exclusions stated including that cover does not reach ordinary commercial shortfall. Registration risk begins only if the member becomes the insured, which is exactly the boundary RCM-019 already enforces.
reopens_if: Dial collects premiums on an insurer's behalf, or arranges cover in which the member is the beneficiary

title: A researched position prices development; a broker quote prices a published tier
decision: The protection charge stands at 4% of credit value on a researched position. Published surety pricing runs 1-3% for contract bonds and to 10% at the licence-bond end, which makes 4% defensible for an unrated principal. Trade credit insurance rates are the wrong comparator: they cover a seller against a buyer, the opposite exposure.
consequence: RCM-019 now distinguishes commercialStage DEVELOPMENT, where a documented researched position suffices, from TIERS_PUBLISHED, where a real quote is required. The open broker question is availability and collateral for an unrated principal, not rate — surety markets often decline rather than price such a principal.
reopens_if: the broker returns a rate materially away from 4%, or declines to write the cover at all

title: The catalogue is a scheduled dependency, not an open blocker
decision: The catalogue and transition flow packs are produced outside this repository and injected against 24_INJECTION_STANDARDS, validated by packages/catalog-coverage/src/injection.ts. They are tracked as a delivery with a date.
consequence: v2.1 steps 7 and 8 are re-read as receive, validate, integrate. Nothing in the programme waits on the catalogue except the Spare customer-ready gates, and no readiness assessment should record it as an open risk.
reopens_if: the delivery date is missed without a new one, at which point it becomes a risk rather than a dependency

title: GMPC is DIAL’s horizontal commercial growth operating layer
decision: Adopt DIAL Growth, Marketing & Promotions Control Centre Rev 2 as the canonical horizontal commercial operating architecture. Allocate its 65 GMPC-F feature anchors and retain its 195 atomic feature-to-page mappings as the implementation-visible completeness boundary beneath those anchors.
consequence: Growth, campaigns, promotions, audiences, journeys, content, social, paid media, SEO, sales growth, merchandising, experiments, attribution, budgets, supplier marketing, AI governance and commercial knowledge are no longer optional side documents. They enter the normal DIAL feature, realization, security, contract, evidence and gate machinery. External marketing SaaS remains an adapter/execution surface, never a DIAL source of truth.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes the GMPC architecture with a later canonical revision

title: GMPC commercial RAG is a DKRF domain profile, never a second retrieval authority
decision: GMPC-F200..F211 specialize and consume DKRF-F001..F022. They may define commercial namespaces, evidence traces, freshness, outcome-linked memory and retrieval policies, but they must use the horizontal DKRF ingestion/retrieval/security fabric. Current campaign, spend, price, stock, capacity, consent and money facts remain structured DIAL source-of-truth reads.
consequence: No parallel vector store, generic growth knowledge database or second RAG authority may be introduced by GMPC. Commercial learning is promoted only after outcome verification and remains lower authority than current deterministic policy/domain truth.
reopens_if: the horizontal DKRF canon itself is superseded through the DIAL architecture decision process

title: Promotions are deterministic and GMPC consumes the canonical margin/finance authorities
decision: AI/Hermes may detect opportunities, simulate, draft and optimise within approved envelopes, but transaction eligibility, stacking, discount limits, margin floors, budgets and spend authority are enforced deterministically. PLAT-F014 remains the single margin/pricing calculation authority and the canonical Finance/Ledger remains the money authority.
consequence: GMPC cannot create a second price setter, margin engine, wallet, settlement ledger or ad-spend money authority. Promotion evaluation fails closed; campaign scale is capacity-aware; consequential spend/discount changes require the configured approval/autonomy policy.
reopens_if: the canonical DIAL pricing or finance architecture is explicitly superseded

title: Oracle owns DIAL development continuity; Claude chat is the owner-facing control console
decision: DIAL development execution, mission persistence, worker dispatch and recovery reside on the Oracle-hosted DIAL orchestration control plane. Claude chat remains the owner-facing interactive console and must read progress and issue commands through a typed DIAL-only control bridge. Claude/Codex model sessions are bounded workers, not the long-lived programme host. A Claude chat session ending or reaching a usage limit does not pause a RUNNING Oracle mission.
consequence: The canonical DIAL root mission is persistent and project-isolated. Claude chat status comes from Oracle evidence rather than conversation memory; Resume/Pause/Reprioritise/Approve/Reject are durable typed control actions. The chat bridge exposes no generic shell, cannot access unrelated Hermes projects, and cannot bypass the existing external-Hermes PRODUCTION_GREEN development gate. Oracle dispatch continues across worker/chat loss until a genuine owner/reviewer/credential/external/safety boundary or programme completion.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly replaces the Oracle-resident DIAL development orchestration and Claude-chat control model

area: DEVELOPMENT / SHARED ORACLE HOST / PROJECT ISOLATION
title: DIAL qualification is project-scoped and may not disrupt other Hermes projects
decision: The Oracle host may run multiple independent Hermes projects. DIAL development qualification, failure injection and continuity tests must target only DIAL-owned processes, DIAL-specific services and DIAL-scoped state. A shared Hermes gateway restart or whole-host reboot is not a DIAL production-green prerequisite.
consequence: Mandatory DIAL qualification uses DIAL-owned Codex process failure, external queued failover, and DIAL-only service continuity. Process selection must be proven through the DIAL process tree rather than an unscoped pgrep. Whole-host reboot testing is optional platform maintenance evidence and requires explicit owner approval/coordination because it affects unrelated projects.
reopens_if: DIAL is moved to a dedicated host with no unrelated workloads, or the product owner explicitly approves a different shared-host maintenance policy

title: VEKL is DIAL’s governed versioned engineering knowledge layer
decision: DIAL adopts VEKL as the only governed path for selectively activating external Agent Skills in material Oracle development packets. External skills are ENGINEERING_GUIDANCE_ONLY: canon, Feature/FRC/security contracts, current code/evidence and gates outrank them. Every ordinary packet resolves and persists a Skill Activation Manifest; approved vendor content is exact-pin/exact-hash and immutable; learned procedural adaptations are separately versioned DIAL wrappers and cannot mutate product truth or authority.
consequence: Research-reference Google/Android revisions are not production pins and cannot activate until DIAL donor qualification, conflict review and deterministic evals pass. Hermes/Sol receives packet-scoped approved skills through DIAL_SKILL_ACTIVATION_DIR; Sonnet fallback receives the exact same pinned skill bodies from the persisted manifest. Runtime failover may not silently change skill versions. VEKL outcome memory remains non-authoritative and project-scoped; no second memory/source-of-truth authority is created.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes the DIAL engineering-knowledge authority model or replaces VEKL with another governed mechanism preserving equal-or-stronger pinning, immutability, failover provenance, learning and source-of-truth boundaries

title: VEKL is a federated engineering resource layer with project-aware ahead-of-work research
decision: DIAL VEKL is not limited to Google/Android Agent Skills. Skills are one governed resource class within a federated engineering knowledge/capability layer spanning official documentation, repositories, release notes, maintainer issues/discussions, package registries, security advisories, qualified tools/plugins/MCPs, DIAL rules/hooks/workflow loops and bounded community evidence. The Oracle Hermes control plane uses exact project-aware GPT-5.6 Sol, falling back to exact Claude Sonnet 5, in read-only mode to presearch the engineering resources likely to be needed by the next 3–5 dependency-safe packets derived from current Project Truth, the Development Plan and mission state. Presearch is advisory and may not reprioritise the programme.
consequence: Every material packet persists one Engineering Knowledge Activation Manifest containing the minimal relevant approved skill/resource set and current research forecast provenance. Passive references are trust/freshness/provenance governed and remain non-executable. Executable resources still require donor/security/conflict/eval/manager qualification. Community/forum material is corroboration/discovery only. Sol/Sonnet failover preserves the same activation provenance. Public research may not receive secrets, customer/payment records or identifiable Health data and cannot change DIAL source-of-truth, provider, money, Health, security or gate authority.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly replaces the federated VEKL resource model or project-aware ahead-of-work research with an equal-or-stronger governed mechanism preserving DIAL authority, privacy, provenance, failover and executable-capability qualification boundaries

title: Exact Sonnet fallback may satisfy development readiness while Sol is temporarily provider-limited
decision: The locked DIAL runtime chain remains GPT-5.6 Sol -> Claude Sonnet 5 -> no third runtime. When exact Sol identity is proven but the live provider state is temporarily ACCOUNT_LIMITED, RATE_LIMITED or MODEL_LIMITED, DIAL may issue a development-only DEVELOPMENT_READY_FALLBACK gate if exact Sonnet 5 is healthy and identity-proven, a real external Oracle queue canary completes through that fallback, VEKL v2 fallback activation and project-aware ahead-of-work research are live-green, repository verification is green, DIAL-only continuity is green and the gate is bound to the current control-plane fingerprint. AUTH_FAILED and PROCESS_FAILED are not eligible temporary-provider states.
consequence: DEVELOPMENT_READY_FALLBACK permits ordinary development only through the persistent external Oracle orchestrator and does not claim PRODUCTION_GREEN, alter product authority, add another model, or weaken contract/reviewer/gate requirements. Sol remains preferred automatically when healthy. Full PRODUCTION_GREEN still requires the existing dual-runtime installed qualification, real DIAL-owned process failover, same-job external failover, Sol recovery and continuity evidence once Sol capacity is available.
reopens_if: the product owner changes the locked runtime chain or replaces the Oracle development-readiness policy with an equal-or-stronger fail-closed mechanism

title: Sol inference capacity is reserved for meaningful manager and mandatory live-certification work
decision: DIAL must preserve GPT-5.6 Sol subscription capacity by using deterministic checks, current runtime health and a fingerprint-bound exact-identity cache before any inference probe. A supervisor/service restart does not invalidate still-valid identity evidence. When Sol reports ACCOUNT_LIMITED, RATE_LIMITED or MODEL_LIMITED, the control plane records the provider retry boundary/cooldown and suppresses further Sol probes, ordinary packet attempts and ahead-of-work Sol research until that boundary; exact Claude Sonnet 5 is used according to the existing locked fallback policy. VEKL ahead-of-work forecasts are invalidated by semantic project/plan/priority/work changes, not volatile mission turn IDs, packet IDs or RUNNING/BLOCKED transitions. Full production qualification may deliberately force the minimum live Sol proofs required by the certification contract, but must reuse those proofs instead of issuing duplicate fixed-token/recovery calls.
consequence: Sol capacity is spent first on meaningful manager/complex implementation/review work and the irreducible live evidence required for full certification, not repeated 'prove you are Sol' traffic. Identity-cache validity is fail-closed against Codex/Hermes/config/control-code fingerprint changes and expiry; provider cooldown never manufactures HEALTHY state; the exact GPT-5.6 Sol -> Claude Sonnet 5 -> no-runtime chain, VEKL provenance, contract/reviewer gates and PRODUCTION_GREEN requirements remain unchanged.
reopens_if: the product owner changes the locked runtime chain, subscription-capacity policy or full-production live-evidence requirements

title: DIAL SEO is a governed programmatic and local discovery system, not an unrestricted content channel
decision: Strengthen GMPC-F080/F081 so all deliberately public, useful DIAL commercial/informational surfaces may participate in SEO under a deterministic versioned Indexability Policy. Programmatic landing pages must be backed by canonical DIAL entity truth and pass unique-value, freshness, duplication, privacy, canonical, structured-data, sitemap and performance gates. Arbitrary facets/internal search/tracking URLs and private/account/transactional/Health-sensitive surfaces are not index inventory. Merchant/search-shopping feeds are generated from canonical commerce truth where supported. Hermes/AI may discover opportunities and draft bounded content but cannot override indexability or fabricate inventory, fitment, price, availability, location, coverage, expertise or reviews.
consequence: The older Spare/Tech-only SEO wording is superseded. GMPC section 22, PREMIUM_CINEMATIC_WEB_STANDARD.md and the GMPC-F080/F081 dedicated acceptance contracts are the canonical SEO implementation boundary. Search success is measured through qualified conversion, fulfilment and contribution rather than ranking/traffic alone. No implementation may claim feature completion with metadata/sitemap/Search Console connectivity alone.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly replaces this SEO/indexability authority with an equal-or-stronger system preserving canonical-truth, anti-doorway, privacy, indexability, structured-data, sitemap/feed, local-discovery and AI-governance guarantees

area: PLATFORM / DEVELOPMENT / TECHNICAL COHESION / PRODUCT ANALYTICS
title: VEKL 2.1 minimal-coalition resolution and bounded PostHog adoption enforce one authority per concern
decision: DIAL adopts a machine-checkable technical-cohesion law: each cross-cutting concern has one canonical DIAL authority and supporting tools remain bounded adapters/projections. VEKL resource selection is upgraded from global top-N ranking to hard-eligibility-first deterministic purpose+role minimal-coalition resolution; Skills have one exact-pin selection owner and generic VEKL resources cannot select them again. PostHog is retained as the canonical product-experience analytics/rollout tool, but only for product/web analytics, privacy-gated replay/heatmaps, bounded staff/dogfood rollout and GMPC-owned experiment assignment/measurement.
consequence: PostHog cannot become a source of truth for money, pricing, authorization, branch certification, eligibility, compliance, Health/claims, fulfilment, surveys, AI observability/evals, technical telemetry, BI or workflow state. Formbricks, Langfuse, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry/Prometheus/Loki/Tempo/Grafana, Metabase, Command Centre and Temporal/BullMQ/n8n retain their existing distinct roles. Optional analytics failure cannot break a core DIAL transaction. The Technical Cohesion Authority Registry is an enforcement projection, not a new truth store.
reopens_if: the product owner replaces this one-authority-per-concern model, PostHog bounded role or VEKL deterministic minimal-coalition law with an equal-or-stronger mechanism preserving source-of-truth, privacy, determinism, failover and anti-overengineering guarantees

area: DEVELOPMENT / ORACLE ORCHESTRATION / OWNER OPERATOR CONTROL
title: Claude, Codex and owner WhatsApp are adapters to one typed DIAL Oracle operator gateway
decision: DIAL owner control uses one project-isolated typed dial_* authority over the persistent Oracle mission. Claude and Codex consume that authority through local MCP adapters; authenticated owner WhatsApp consumes it through either the paired Hermes self-chat adapter or the official Meta Cloud API adapter. No operator channel exposes a generic shell/filesystem primitive or becomes a second orchestration authority. Recognized WhatsApp shortcuts retain typed command semantics, while other authenticated owner prose is converted only into dial_submit_instruction. The paired Hermes owner channel may also ingest bounded supported documents/images into a content-addressed control-root intake and queue them as steering context. Important persisted mission events are pushed automatically with cursor deduplication. All writes remain idempotent and channel-attributed, and status comes from Oracle/repository evidence rather than conversation or client-local state.
consequence: Oracle remains responsible for mission persistence, queueing, runtime selection, recovery and continuation. Full-text WhatsApp steering is convenience at the typed instruction boundary, not direct execution authority; the locked GPT-5.6 Sol -> exact Claude Sonnet 5 runtime chain, VEKL, repository truth and development gates are unchanged. Owner uploads are source-path validated, size/type bounded, mode-0600 and content-addressed before the manager is instructed to inspect them; executable/macro formats are excluded. WhatsApp owner identity remains fail-closed, and automatic notifications return only to the verified owner channel. Customer/business WhatsApp remains separate from development operator authority.
reopens_if: the product owner replaces the unified operator authority or channel authentication model with an equal-or-stronger mechanism preserving DIAL-only isolation, typed/no-shell control, idempotency, Oracle persistence, source-of-truth/gate authority and owner-only WhatsApp authentication

area: DEVELOPMENT / ENGINEERING KNOWLEDGE / GRAPHRAG / PROJECT TRUTH EVOLUTION
title: VEKL 2.2 uses stable Development Units, deterministic GraphRAG, immutable traces and owner-only canon evolution
decision: Adopt DIAL VEKL 2.2 REV 2 as an additive extension of DEC-020 and DEC-024. Development knowledge is compiled into a rebuildable graph of stable Unit lineages and immutable revisions; graph-first retrieval bounds semantic ranking; every material dispatch records a pinned determinism envelope, context capsules and KnowledgeResolutionTrace; conflicting research is withheld from execution and may enter a deterministic challenge lane; only an exact owner-only DIAL_CANON_CHALLENGE_DECISION may authorize a canon supersession/revision.
consequence: No vector/graph system becomes Project Truth. VEKL 2.1 hard eligibility/minimal-coalition remains the activation owner. Unit/graph/contract/stack/route freshness is transactionally rechecked before execution and consequential effects; stale knowledge fails closed. UI-bearing units require Product Experience knowledge. Locked decisions evolve by supersession/revision and critical challenges reuse existing mission blocking.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes VEKL 2.2 with an equal-or-stronger architecture preserving authority safety, deterministic/replayable retrieval, stale-admission refusal, immutable evidence and owner-only canon change

area: DEVELOPMENT / HERMES / XKIRO HAIF AUTHORITY HYGIENE
title: xKiro HAIF remains a non-authoritative auxiliary fabric under a dedicated locked Decision identity
decision: Repair the compact Project Truth Decision reference for Hermes xKiro HAIF without renumbering or mutating any existing locked Decision. HAIF remains FREE_ONLY, non-authoritative, no-tools, no-repository-writes, not a DIAL manager runtime and not a Project Truth, money, Health or deployment authority.
consequence: Project Truth references DEC-027 for the HAIF lock. DEC-023 remains unchanged as the locked SEO/indexability Decision. This is identifier/authority hygiene only and does not broaden xKiro authority.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly changes HAIF authority or provider policy

title: VEKL 2.2 remains the knowledge authority while DIAL adds a worker-only adaptive execution fabric
decision: Adopt the reconciled Adaptive Multi-Harness Execution Fabric Rev 2 beneath VEKL 2.2. Material work is deterministically triaged into an immutable Task Execution Envelope bound to current VEKL evidence; HCX hard-filters worker-only capabilities before empirical routing; compute is transactionally reserved; the minimum safe topology is selected; workers receive role projections from existing VEKL capsules; repository writers require repository-wide path leases and fencing; donor/design providers remain non-authoritative candidates; acceptance remains with deterministic verification, Product Experience/security/FRC/Unit gates; admitted work emits an immutable Development Execution Receipt.
consequence: No second VEKL, Project Truth, mission controller, manager-runtime policy, design authority or donor SoR is created. GPT-5.6 Sol -> exact Claude Sonnet 5 remains the manager-runtime chain. HAIF remains auxiliary. Budget/provider outages may block or reroute but cannot waive mandatory review. Superseded/fenced worker results are non-admissible. Stitch is optional development tooling only. A2A and Temporal remain deferred pending a separately authorized need.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes this adaptive execution model with an equal-or-stronger mechanism preserving VEKL authority, manager isolation, stale refusal, write fencing, provider non-authority and evidence-accounted admission

title: VEKL may use an exact-pinned sanitized Zie619 n8n workflow corpus as non-executable engineering reference knowledge
decision: Adopt the reconciled VEKL x Zie619/n8n-workflows Corpus Integration Rev 2. The exact-pinned community corpus is ingested only through ephemeral quarantine and deterministic sanitization/security analysis, compressed into bounded positive/anti-pattern EXAMPLE_REFERENCE resources, and resolved only through the existing graph-first VEKL minimal-coalition, Activation Manifest, KnowledgeResolutionTrace, worker-delivery and AEF envelope path. official.n8n remains a distinct T1 official source. Unknown n8n/node compatibility is fail-closed and never represented as runtime-compatible.
consequence: No raw workflow execution, raw searchable corpus, new graph ontology, synthetic task taxonomy, second automation database, second VEKL, second Hermes plane or runtime-owner override is created. Temporal/BullMQ/n8n/domain-service ownership, official WhatsApp authority, money authority, manager-runtime policy and specialist Dial Health boundaries remain unchanged. Generic Zie619 community patterns are blocked for specialist Health Units. Corpus refreshes are candidate generations until explicitly promoted.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes the external automation-knowledge model while preserving Project Truth superiority, non-execution, deterministic provenance, hard eligibility, runtime ownership, privacy/security and stale-context refusal

area: DEVELOPMENT / ORACLE ORCHESTRATION / HYBRID OWNER STEERING
title: Current owner direction uses a hybrid safe-boundary Hermes steering lane
decision: Supersede only the queue-only normal-owner-action semantics of DEC-025. Claude, Codex and authenticated owner WhatsApp remain adapters to one DIAL-only typed Oracle authority, but normal owner actions use dial_owner_steer: acknowledge immediately, block subsequent autonomous dispatch, allow any current repository writer to reach a safe boundary, then execute the steer through the locked GPT-5.6 Sol -> exact Claude Sonnet 5 runtime before autonomous work resumes. Read-only questions use dial_owner_live_turn without serializing writers; dial_submit_instruction is deliberate background queueing only. Supported owner uploads enter the same steer lane.
consequence: The owner is not buried behind the autonomous queue and active repository writes are not killed or raced. Owner-steer execution carries authenticated owner provenance into Project Truth authority roots and supersedes/revokes affected AEF envelopes and leases at the safe execution boundary. xKiro may advise only from coarse PUBLIC metadata and is non-authoritative. No generic shell/filesystem authority, second orchestrator, new manager runtime, or customer/business WhatsApp authority is created.
supersedes: DEC-025 normal-owner-action queueing semantics only; DEC-025 DIAL-only typed gateway, channel authentication, idempotency, Oracle persistence and no-shell boundaries remain in force
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly replaces the hybrid steering model with an equal-or-stronger mechanism preserving DIAL-only isolation, owner precedence, safe-boundary serialization, owner provenance, AEF supersession/fencing, read-only query immediacy, no-shell control, Oracle persistence and owner-only WhatsApp authentication

area: DEVELOPMENT / DESIGN / GMPC / GOOGLE EXTERNAL CAPABILITIES
title: Antigravity, Stitch and Pomelli use one governed external-capability admission model with Pomelli owned by GMPC
decision: Adopt DIAL Google External Capabilities Rev 3 as the canonical reconciliation of the Antigravity/Stitch/Pomelli blueprint, the multi-harness/Stitch engineering specification and AEF Rev 2. Antigravity is a worker-only engineering harness beneath VEKL/AEF; Stitch is a non-authoritative design-generation provider beneath DIAL Design Authority; Pomelli is a GMPC external creative provider whose connection/admission state may be shared but whose Business DNA, asset lifecycle, reviews, commercial binding, approval, publication, expiry and revocation remain GMPC-owned. External capability maturity is explicit and no provider may be called INTEGRATED or the programme PRODUCTION_GREEN without provider-specific live and orchestrated evidence.
consequence: The prior false-green condition is prohibited. Provider absence/fallback safety does not prove integration. Antigravity/Stitch credentials remain tooling-only; Pomelli browser sessions are human-operated and never stored/automated by DIAL. Provider outputs are candidates until admitted by existing DIAL authority. No provider becomes manager runtime, Project Truth, design authority, GMPC commercial truth, pricing/promotion/money authority or customer transactional runtime. Existing GPT-5.6 Sol -> Claude Sonnet 5 manager policy, VEKL, AEF, Design Authority, GMPC and domain SoRs remain superior.
reopens_if: the product owner explicitly supersedes this external-capability model with an equal-or-stronger mechanism preserving Project Truth/VEKL/AEF/design/GMPC authority, provider non-authority, secret isolation, live qualification, evidence-accounted maturity, rollback and no-false-green guarantees
